author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಒಂಟಿಯಾಗಿರೆ ನೀನು ದೇವನಿರುವನು ಜೊತೆಗೆ
ಘಟಕನಾಗಿಹನವನು ನಿನ್ನೊಳಗೆ ಇದ್ದು
ನೆಂಟರಿಷ್ಟರು ಬರರು ಸಂಕಟದಿ ನೀನಿರಲು
ಹಠವಿರಲು ಬೆಳೆಯುವೆಯೊ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: If you are alone, God is with you;
he is part of you, dwelling within;
relatives and friends won’t come when you are in trouble;
if you have grit, you will grow, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Even when we are alone, the Divine within stays with us. Relatives may not come in hard times, but determination lets us grow.
